03116 Yuwkal {yoo-kal'}

03081 之一型; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Jucal 1; 1

猶甲 = "耶和華是大有能力的"
1) 示利米雅的兒子, 西底家王的臣僕, 被王派去求耶利米的祝禱與忠言  (#耶38:1|)

03116 Yuwkal {yoo-kal'}

a form of 03081;; n pr m

AV - Jucal 1; 1

Jucal = "Jehovah is able"
1) a son of Shelemiah and a servant of king Zedekiah whom he sent to
   Jeremiah to entreat his prayers and advice
